candidates.change_summary: Replace the selfdestruct target so the contract is sent to the stored owner address instead of msg.sender, changing which address receives remaining ether and altering post-call observable effects.
Remove the owner check by changing the require to allow any caller, making sudicideAnyone callable by anyone and thus changing observable behavior.
Change the selfdestruct beneficiary to the zero address, which consumes funds differently and changes observable post-call state.
